title: Match Node parsing for equals-form values beginning with a dash
outcome: Match Node parsing for equals-form values beginning with a dash
acceptance: Focused Node routing accepts nonempty equals-form values such as --title=-x and --test-name-pattern=-flaky according to Node's parser, while keeping empty or invalid separated values refused and preserving escaped separated values.
Regression coverage exercises equals and separated/escaped values, including a real native Node invocation, without loosening Vitest module-routing or owned-JSON credit guards.
